criteria.criterion: Agent time = work + review session durations; plan time is reported apart; gate time is the sum of iteration/v1 gate durations and unknown (null, shown `n/a`) for the shell loop; wall time = plan commit's committer time to the last run commit's. Rates use agent time: delivered code lines per minute, and code + test.
criteria.evidence: time.go Aggregate: AgentMS=Work+Review, PlanMS separate, GateMS nil unless an iteration has GateMS, WallMS=Run.Time-Plan.Time, rates divide by agent minutes; TestTimeCostWorkedExample and TestTimeCostSumsGateDurations… assert these.

criteria.criterion: Cost per phase and total are sums of unrounded session costs (rounding only at display); cost per 1,000 delivered code lines; tokens input, output, cache read and cache creation summed, cache-hit ratio = cache read / (input + cache read + cache creation). Models per phase are the distinct models in the sessions' model usage, sorted and comma-joined; effort per phase where session/v1 records carry it.
criteria.evidence: Aggregate sums s.CostUSD unrounded, Per1kCode via fratio, token sums from Models, CacheHit formula matches, joinSet sorts and joins; worked example asserts 2.10, 140 per 1k, 400/640, models, and the multi-model/effort test asserts 'a,b' and 'high,low'.

criteria.criterion: Tasks: planned, done and blocked are counted in the plan at the last run commit; first-pass = tasks whose only iteration outcome is `done`; the estimate is the brief's `<n> to <m> tasks` phrase (absent when the brief states none); iterations per closed task is also computed.
criteria.evidence: CountTasks counts plan statuses from the supplied PlanDoc, onlyDone for first-pass, BriefEstimate regex, IterationsPerClosed; TestTasks… cover these including the no-estimate case.

criteria.criterion: Missing records: an iteration whose outcome means a review ran (`done`, `review_fail`, `rejected`) without a review session record, or any iteration without a work session record, is reported as `<task> <phase> (iteration <i>)`; its time and cost are not counted and nothing is estimated in their place.
criteria.evidence: MissingRecords uses reviewRan and the work/review session lookup and formats as required; TestMissingRecordsReportedAndNotEstimated expects exactly 'T1 review (iteration 1)' and 'T4 work (iteration 5)' and checks the review totals are only the existing records.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests `TestTimeCost…`, `TestTasks…` and `TestMissingRecords…` in internal/metrics cover each rule with fixtures in temporary directories, including a plan session in a separate folder and a blocked-then-done task (not first-pass).
criteria.evidence: time_test.go has all three prefixes; fixtures use t.TempDir; workedRun puts the plan session in its own folder; TestTasksBlockedThenDoneIsNotFirstPass covers the blocked-then-done case.

notes: Aggregate and CountTasks take the plan and delivered counts as arguments, so T8 must supply the plan as committed at the last run commit. Missing-record matching is by phase/iteration within a run folder. No absolute paths found.
